name: Edwyna API
description:
Edwyna is an API-only, paid outbound fax service powered by FaxZero.
This contract covers supported United States and Canada destinations, one PDF,
one recipient, and a maximum of 25 pages.

Creating a draft is synchronous and non-consequential: the request waits
for isolated PDF validation and returns either a ready fax with an exact
server-generated quote or a structured rejection without creating a fax.
There is no validation-status polling step. Preparation requires enough available Edwyna credit to
cover the quote, but does not deduct that credit. Sending is consequential:
it deducts prepaid balance and queues an external fax transmission. Every
send request requires an idempotency key.
